'''Rich McNanna''' is an American voice actor for the English dub of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Pokémon==
McNanna joined the cast during the latter half of the [[S09|Pokémon: Battle Frontier]] season of {{aniseries|RS}}. Currently, his most famous role is that of [[Jack Walker]].
